prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1219; do not mention it.)
text:
I write on behalf of our client regarding a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle sideswiped our client's vehicle while changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know.

We request that you provide the policy limits of liability coverage applicable to the insured driver and vehicle involved in this collision, along with a copy of the declarations page.

Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this incident, including photographs, dash camera or telematics data, witness statements, recorded calls, claim notes, adjuster reports, and the insured's vehicle and any related repair records. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions in any subsequent litigation.
